## Activity

East City Eye Clinic completed its scheduled retinal photography activity during October 2024. A total of 224 captures were recorded across the clinic’s sessions. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that the service continued to operate as expected during the reporting period, with captures submitted for grading following each session.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. Graders identified 5 captures as ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 2.2 of all captures. These images could not be assessed reliably and should be considered in routine feedback to the service. The result provides a basis for reviewing image acquisition and reinforcing any local processes that support consistent image quality.

## Grading

Grading identified 61 referable results from the activity completed in October 2024. The median lag between image capture and grading was 2 days. This indicates that images were generally processed within a reasonable interval after acquisition. The site should continue to monitor referral outcomes and grading timeliness through its routine review arrangements, while maintaining the current session-planning approach.
